protocol.matching: one-to-one without replacement; maximum cardinality then minimum absolute log-count distance
protocol.score_direction: larger kurtosis predicts Meadow; fixed before matching

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%; conditions on chosen pairs and fitted encoders

protocol.limitation: Descriptive analysis of previously inspected test scores; overlapping size support only. No classifier fitting, no area adjustment beyond native pixel count, no equal-pixel resampling.
